The GPG agent receives requests from GnuPG, then forwards them to the Keyguard app instead of handling the sensitive operation itself.

The communication is done in two steps: first the agent signals the app to start a session, then both sides connect over a local TCP channel and exchange encrypted messages. The GPG agent acts as a relay, while the Keyguard app performs the actual operations.
